scenes.name: 01-intro
scenes.caption: DelayLens: when should I leave to arrive on time? A recorded-data demo, not live travel advice.

scenes.name: 02-form
scenes.caption: Bus 29, Mornington Crescent to Tottenham Court Road. Saturday 24 October, 17:00 London; walks 5 + 5 minutes.

scenes.name: 03-curve
scenes.caption: Each possible departure gets an estimated on-time chance and a 90% uncertainty band. The source and sample count stay visible.

scenes.name: 03-advice
scenes.caption: Leave by 16:22: an estimated 92% on-time chance. The page shows the uncertainty and recorded support.

scenes.name: 04-later
scenes.caption: Leave five minutes later and the estimated chance falls to about 75%. The comparison updates in the browser.

scenes.name: 05-map
scenes.caption: The map separates walking from the uncertain wait and ride. It does not measure delays at individual stops.

scenes.name: 06-no-advice
scenes.caption: For a 15:30 deadline, no departure meets the 90% target on these recordings. DelayLens gives no recommendation.

scenes.name: 07-method
scenes.caption: TfL supplies predictions. Arrivals are inferred, not measured. Calibration remains preliminary; one Saturday cannot establish general reliability.

scenes.name: 08-close
scenes.caption: The form works without Gemini or a database. This backup uses the frozen 20:25Z snapshot; live arrivals, voice and live Gemini are not demonstrated.

curveResults.basis: Based on 56 trips recorded on this route (Sat 24 Oct 14:49 - Sat 24 Oct 21:02, London time), replaying ±60 min around each departure. Arrivals are estimated from TfL predictions, not measured; not yet calibrated. Offline snapshot frozen 24 Oct 20:25 UTC; not live data.
